_note: Townsfolk who stand out can be promoted at dawn. When someone qualifies, a Promote card takes one of the dawn card slots; taking it costs shells and means no newcomer that dawn. warrior: after kills enemies a warrior can become a named hero of class becomes at start_level (needs a lodging, like any hero card). champion: a champion hero of at least level can be knighted (becomes that class) once the class's building stands. craftsperson: after made goods at one workshop a craftsperson can become a named master of that workshop, with one of traits: craft_rate multiplies their speed at their own bench, affix_chance adds to the chance of an affixed item, extra_tier adds to the tier of gear they make.

meticulous.name: Meticulous
meticulous.text: Slow and careful: more of their gear comes out with an affix.

quick_hands.name: Quick hands
quick_hands.text: Works twice as fast, but their gear is plain.

gifted.name: Gifted
gifted.text: Their gear comes out one tier better.
